claims.supported_claim: Begin success with lost acknowledgement triggers immediate rollback; rollback failure exits the worker. Successful Commit/Rollback with lost ack sets ignore_next_start_rollback to avoid rolling back a completed transaction when the Transaction later drops.
claims.limitations: ['Worker acknowledgement is not the C# application result, and lost acknowledgement must not be translated into a false rollback conclusion. Custom BEGIN validation moved into worker in 0.9.'] Reader is interop_design; not independently reread by database_design.

claims.supported_claim: start_rollback and shutdown synchronously send into the bounded command channel. Shutdown handling drops connection references before ack and then exits its loop.
claims.limitations: ['These send calls can block. They must not run directly in NativeWeave nonblocking request_stop/try_retire/ReleaseHandle/reverse callback. Ack occurs before closure return; it is not an OS JoinHandle proof.'] Reader is interop_design; not independently reread by database_design.

claims.supported_claim: Graceful close may execute PRAGMA optimize, then requests worker shutdown, drops self and awaits confirmation. close_hard drops self and immediately returns; flush is no-op.
claims.limitations: ['close_hard/Drop/flush are not proof of worker completion or NativeWeave quiescence. Run potentially blocking cleanup from a controlled native blocking lane/supervisor, keep ownership until confirmed.'] Reader is interop_design; not independently reread by database_design.
